title: Water Bill Tracking Rate Change Watch
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:bill bill_type="water"
| stats earliest(rate_per_gallon) as start_rate latest(rate_per_gallon) as current_rate by provider
| eval rate_change_pct=round(100*(current_rate-start_rate)/start_rate,1)
| sort - abs(rate_change_pct)
description: Measures how much the effective rate behind water bill tracking has moved over the captured history.
value: Rate-plan changes are often where bill surprises start, so watching the rate itself is cleaner than only watching the total bill.
implementation: Store the effective unit rate for each bill or tariff update even when the provider site only shows the statement total.
visualization: Table of providers with starting rate, current rate, and percent change.
grandmaExplanation: It lists when the price behind water bill tracking has changed more than you realized.
